dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in the 2D geometric width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult phenotype.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple longitudinal, parallel light-colored linear streaks (rake marks) visible along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive longitudinal linear scarring or rake marks along the dorsal midline.
